features.title: Freedom model and spend guards
criteria: Missing policy context fails closed; replication and runtime self-modification are always denied while other tools follow owner settings
Pause, disabled payments and payment price caps block paid inference, top-ups and x402 without any network request
Per-call, hourly and daily inference limits use correct cent units and persist across restart
Upstream tool policy is unchanged when no moneyLab profile is configured
The project typechecks and builds

implementation.note: Implemented in src/money-lab and narrow upstream patches; see money-lab/INTEGRATION.md

features.title: Experiment and help journal
criteria: Experiments can be created and updated in parallel with merged evidence and metrics
Help requests survive restart; repeated or unrelated resolutions cannot unblock or re-wake
Funding, credit purchases, consumed costs, estimated revenue, confirmed revenue and cash stay separate
Repeated no-progress cycles trigger a long sleep while experiment context is kept

implementation.note: Implemented in src/money-lab (journal, cli, status, cycle); see money-lab/INTEGRATION.md

features.title: Operator status, pause and resume
criteria: Operator can pause and resume; status states that Conway hosting is still billed while paused
Malformed ledger input is rejected

implementation.note: Implemented in src/money-lab (journal, cli, status, cycle); see money-lab/INTEGRATION.md

features.title: Self-hosted runtime and survival
criteria: Runs without Conway: local execution, Conway-only operations refused, secrets removed from the agent shell
Balance is funding plus confirmed revenue minus spending including accrued hosting; estimated revenue never counts
Below zero the bot makes no inference call, notifies the owner once and revives after funding
Claude requests carry effort, auto tool choice and the default refusal fallback, never replay thinking, and handle refusals

features.title: Telegram owner channel
criteria: Only the owner chat is served; other text reaches the bot as an inbox message and wakes it
Commands fund the bot, answer help requests, pause and resume; queued notifications and one daily summary are delivered
Errors never include the bot token

features.title: Stripe revenue sync
criteria: Charges, fees, refunds and payouts map to ledger entries with the owner's conversion rate
Sync is idempotent, skips other currencies, extends survival and notifies the owner
